humor_and_voices: Neet turns ordinary shopping into military telemetry; Buddy physically removes Houston and declares Signal lost, giving the opening both a visual gag and a distinct comfort-seeking countervoice. The failed bone adjustment supplies a quiet pause.

Buddy has his own costly curiosity after correctly warning about chutney, then his own self-interested success taking the treat while refusing to block Neet. FLAMING JUSTICE is a motivated temporary loss of his normal restraint.
Heather acts promptly with water and attempts the treat lure; Sagar supplies the second cup and accepts the extra jug. Their practical and amused reactions remain distinct.
causality_and_timing: Shopping establishes the later toy; the green chutney causes expressly literal cartoon fire, Buddy edges closer before his singed-tail sprint, and Heather extinguishes it. Singed fur tips are explicitly the whole injury, preserving affectionate cartoon stakes.
The spider stays in the mouth during its carry image and is pinned only after exhaustion. The short paw/squeak/withdrawal pauses make the threshold crossing funny without an illustration spoiling it.
emotional_payoff: The uttapam peace treaty earns its calm: Buddy checks both portions, Neet waits for his nod and moves the toy away. Heather placing the water jug within reach recalls lunch while allowing the household to settle.
Literal cartoon fire, tail singe, six-legged budget spider and uttapam are all preserved; the ending remains warm and comically cautious.
